import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Check for association with outcome
    pvals = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col]
        y = feats.y
        tstat, pval = stats.ttest_ind(x[y==1], x[y==0], equal_var=False)
        pvals.append(pval)
    
    # Find significant features (p < 0.05)
    sig_features = [fid for fid, p in zip(feats.ids, pvals) if p < 0.05]
    
    # If no significant features, return empty design
    if not sig_features:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Check for correlation among significant features
    corr_pairs = []
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(sig_features):
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(sig_features[i+1:], i+1):
            col1 = feats.column(fid1)
            col2 = feats.column(fid2)
            r, _ = stats.pearsonr(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])
            if abs(r) >= 0.6:
                corr_pairs.append((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (keep one from each pair)
    to_remove = set()
    for a, b in corr_pairs:
        to_remove.add(b)  # remove second in pair
    
    unique_features = [f for f in sig_features if f not in to_remove]
    
    # Check strata consistency
    stratum_pvals = []
    for fid in unique_features:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col]
        pval = 1.0
        # Test across strata
        for stratum in set(feats.stratum):
            mask = np.array([s == stratum for s in feats.stratum])
            if np.sum(mask) > 1:
                x_stratum = x[mask]
                y_stratum = y[mask]
                if len(np.unique(y_stratum)) > 1:
                    tstat, p = stats.ttest_ind(x_stratum[y_stratum==1], x_stratum[y_stratum==0], equal_var=False)
                    pval = min(pval, p)
        stratum_pvals.append(pval)
    
    # Only keep features with consistent effect across strata
    final_features = [fid for fid, p in zip(unique_features, stratum_pvals) if p < 0.05]
    
    # If no features pass strata check, return empty design
    if not final_features:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build design using top features (max 4 drivers as requested)
    drivers = tuple(final_features[:4])  # Changed from MAX_DRIVERS to 4
    columns = tuple(final_features)
    
    # Add interaction terms for correlated features
    products = []
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(final_features):
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(final_features[i+1:], i+1):
            col1 = feats.column(fid1)
            col2 = feats.column(fid2)
            r, _ = stats.pearsonr(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])
            if abs(r) >= 0.6:
                products.append((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Create loadings for weighted score
    loadings = {}
    for fid in final_features:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col]
        y = feats.y
        tstat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x[y==1], x[y==0], equal_var=False)
        loadings[fid] = tstat
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
